visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with pigtails in a white embroidered shirt stands in a brightly lit hallway. An adult finger points towards her face as she looks down with a concerned expression. Text overlays appear at the bottom and a peach logo is at the top. (2) The girl walks away towards a room with a height chart on the wall, looking back suspiciously. Her facial muscles are tense as she refuses to touch the finger, waving her hand dismissively while the lighting remains bright and natural. (3) The toddler stands near a bathroom entrance with marble tiles, touching her cheek where she was shocked. She looks towards the camera with wide eyes and a slight pout, wearing a floral patterned skirt under her white top. (4) In a close-up, the girl continues to refuse interaction, showing a small red mark on her face. She eventually turns to walk towards a door, waving her hand while looking over her shoulder with a playful yet firm demeanor. (5) The girl interacts with a person with blonde hair sitting on the floor. They exchange high-fives and the girl smiles broadly, her eyes crinkling. The background shows a modern home interior with wooden floors and minimalist furniture. (6) The girl leans in for a deep hug with the blonde-haired person, her head resting on their shoulder. The camera captures her back view and then shifts to a front view of her laughing as they play high-fives.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female adult voice speaks with high pitch and warm tonality, questioning a child about being shocked. The child responds with soft, hesitant vocals. A playful, high-tempo piano BGM with a bouncy rhythm plays continuously in the background. (2) A sudden shift occurs as the child voice becomes more forceful and louder, shouting I don't want you with high arousal. The adult tone remains teasing and humorous. The piano BGM persists with steady beat strength and no pauses. (3) The acoustic environment shifts to the child voice repeating bye-bye in a rhythmic, chanting pattern. The adult voice follows, maintaining a professional yet affectionate narrative tone. Transient ambient noise of movement is audible. (4) Distinct percussion-like clap SFX are heard multiple times as the child and adult high-five. The child vocalizations change to pure laughter and squeals of delight, indicating very high valence. The BGM remains consistent in its cheerful, major-key melody. (5) The audio concludes with a short, synthesized melodic jingle that accompanies the appearance of the graphic logo. The previous piano music fades out quickly into a studio-silent background floor with no incidental noise.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Observation -> Reaction -> Reconciliation -> Playful Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To capture and share a humorous and heartwarming daily interaction between a toddler and her guardian, specifically focusing on the child's cute reaction to static electricity and her subsequent playfulness.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses subtitles and variety-show style text to emphasize the child's speech and reactions, making it highly engaging for a social media audience interested in parenting and family content.
